const BUILTINS = ["__LINE__","__FILE__","__COUNTER__"]
const VARIADIC_NAME = "__VA_ARGS__"
const VARIADIC_ERROR = "\"__VA_ARGS__\" can only appear in the expansion of a variadic macro"
struct DefinitionError <: Exception
    message::String
end
mutable struct MacroDefinition
    name::String
    parameters::Union{Nothing,Vector{String}}
    variadic::Bool
    replacement::Vector{PPToken}
    position::Tuple{String,Int}
    main_file::Bool
    expanded::Int
    tested::Int
end
function signature(definition)
    definition.parameters === nothing && return definition.name
    parameters = copy(definition.parameters)
    definition.variadic && (parameters[end] = "...")
    definition.name * "(" * join(parameters,", ") * ")"
end
function identical_definition(first,second)
    first.parameters == second.parameters && first.variadic == second.variadic &&
        [(t.spelling,t.space) for t in first.replacement] == [(t.spelling,t.space) for t in second.replacement]
end
function check_macro_name(tokens,directive)
    isempty(tokens) && return "no macro name given in #$directive directive"
    tokens[1].kind == "identifier" || return "macro names must be identifiers"
    name = tokens[1].spelling
    name == "defined" && return "\"defined\" cannot be used as a macro name"
    if name in BUILTINS
        operation = directive == "define" ? "redefine" : "undefine"
        return "cannot $operation builtin macro \"$name\""
    end
    nothing
end
function parse_definition(tokens,position,main_file)
    error = check_macro_name(tokens,"define")
    error === nothing || throw(DefinitionError(error))
    name = tokens[1].spelling
    name == VARIADIC_NAME && throw(DefinitionError(VARIADIC_ERROR))
    parameters,variadic,index = nothing,false,2
    if length(tokens) > 1 && tokens[2].spelling == "(" && !tokens[2].space
        parameters,index = String[],3
        index > length(tokens) && throw(DefinitionError("missing ')' in macro parameter list"))
        if tokens[index].spelling == ")"
            index += 1
        else
            while true
                index > length(tokens) && throw(DefinitionError("missing ')' in macro parameter list"))
                token = tokens[index]
                if token.spelling == "..."
                    push!(parameters,VARIADIC_NAME)
                    variadic = true
                elseif token.kind == "identifier"
                    token.spelling == VARIADIC_NAME && throw(DefinitionError(VARIADIC_ERROR))
                    token.spelling in parameters && throw(DefinitionError("duplicate macro parameter \"$(token.spelling)\""))
                    push!(parameters,token.spelling)
                else
                    throw(DefinitionError("expected parameter name, found \"$(token.spelling)\""))
                end
                index += 1
                index > length(tokens) && throw(DefinitionError("missing ')' in macro parameter list"))
                following = tokens[index].spelling
                index += 1
                following == ")" && break
                variadic && throw(DefinitionError("expected ')' after \"...\", found \"$following\""))
                following == "," || throw(DefinitionError("expected ',' or ')', found \"$following\""))
            end
        end
    end
    replacement = copy(tokens[index:end])
    if !isempty(replacement)
        replacement[1] = token_with(replacement[1];space=false)
        (replacement[1].spelling == "##" || replacement[end].spelling == "##") && throw(DefinitionError("'##' cannot appear at either end of a macro expansion"))
    end
    for (index,token) in enumerate(replacement)
        token.kind == "identifier" && token.spelling == VARIADIC_NAME && !variadic && throw(DefinitionError(VARIADIC_ERROR))
        if token.spelling == "#" && parameters !== nothing
            if index == length(replacement) || replacement[index+1].kind != "identifier" || !(replacement[index+1].spelling in parameters)
                throw(DefinitionError("'#' is not followed by a macro parameter"))
            end
        end
    end
    MacroDefinition(name,parameters,variadic,replacement,position,main_file,0,0)
end

mutable struct Expander
    macros::Dict{String,MacroDefinition}
    diagnostic::Function
    counter::Int
    builtin_counts::Dict{String,Int}
end
Expander(macros,diagnostic) = Expander(macros,diagnostic,0,Dict{String,Int}())
expansion_error!(expander,context,token,message) = expander.diagnostic(display_position(context,token.line),"error",message)
function expand_builtin!(expander,token,context)
    expander.builtin_counts[token.spelling] = get(expander.builtin_counts,token.spelling,0)+1
    if token.spelling == "__FILE__"
        kind,spelling = "string","\"" * context.display_file * "\""
    elseif token.spelling == "__LINE__"
        kind,spelling = "number",string(display_position(context,token.line)[2])
    else
        kind,spelling = "number",string(expander.counter)
        expander.counter += 1
    end
    PPToken(kind,spelling,token.line,token.space)
end
function collect_arguments!(expander,pending,definition,token,context)
    arguments,separators,nesting = [PPToken[]],PPToken[],0
    closing,consumed = nothing,0
    for (index,current) in enumerate(Iterators.reverse(pending))
        index == 1 && continue
        if current.spelling == ")" && nesting == 0
            closing,consumed = current,index
            break
        elseif current.spelling == "," && nesting == 0
            push!(separators,current)
            push!(arguments,PPToken[])
        else
            current.spelling == "(" && (nesting += 1)
            current.spelling == ")" && (nesting -= 1)
            push!(arguments[end],current)
        end
    end
    if closing === nothing
        expansion_error!(expander,context,token,"unterminated argument list invoking macro \"$(definition.name)\"")
        return nothing
    end
    argument_count = length(arguments)
    fixed = length(definition.parameters)-Int(definition.variadic)
    error = nothing
    if !definition.variadic && fixed == 0 && (argument_count != 1 || !isempty(arguments[1]))
        error = "macro \"$(definition.name)\" passed $argument_count arguments, but takes just 0"
    elseif argument_count < fixed
        error = "macro \"$(definition.name)\" requires $fixed arguments, but only $argument_count given"
    elseif argument_count > fixed && !definition.variadic
        error = "macro \"$(definition.name)\" passed $argument_count arguments, but takes just $fixed"
    end
    if error !== nothing
        expansion_error!(expander,context,token,error)
        return nothing
    end
    raw = Dict{String,Vector{PPToken}}(definition.parameters[index]=>arguments[index] for index in 1:fixed)
    if definition.variadic
        variable = PPToken[]
        for index in fixed+1:argument_count
            index > fixed+1 && push!(variable,separators[index-1])
            append!(variable,arguments[index])
        end
        raw[VARIADIC_NAME] = variable
    end
    raw,consumed,closing
end
function stringize(tokens,sharp)
    pieces = String[]
    for (index,token) in enumerate(tokens)
        index > 1 && token.space && push!(pieces," ")
        spelling = token.spelling
        if token.kind in ("string","character")
            spelling = replace(spelling,"\\"=>"\\\\","\""=>"\\\"")
        end
        push!(pieces,spelling)
    end
    PPToken("string","\"" * join(pieces) * "\"",sharp.line,sharp.space)
end
function paste_tokens!(expander,left,right,token,context)
    left.kind == "placemarker" && return [token_with(right;space=left.space)]
    right.kind == "placemarker" && return [left]
    spelling = left.spelling * right.spelling
    kind = single_token(spelling)
    if kind !== nothing
        return [PPToken(kind,spelling,left.line,left.space,intersect(left.hide,right.hide))]
    end
    expansion_error!(expander,context,token,"pasting \"$(left.spelling)\" and \"$(right.spelling)\" does not give a valid preprocessing token")
    [left,token_with(right;space=false)]
end
function substitute!(expander,definition,raw,token,hide,context)
    replacement = definition.replacement
    items = Union{PPToken,Vector{PPToken}}[]
    expanded = Dict{String,Vector{PPToken}}()
    index = 1
    while index <= length(replacement)
        current = replacement[index]
        if current.spelling == "#" && definition.parameters !== nothing
            push!(items,[stringize(raw[replacement[index+1].spelling],current)])
            index += 2
            continue
        elseif current.spelling == "##"
            push!(items,current)
        elseif current.kind == "identifier" && haskey(raw,current.spelling)
            adjacent = (index > 1 && replacement[index-1].spelling == "##") || (index < length(replacement) && replacement[index+1].spelling == "##")
            if adjacent
                sequence = raw[current.spelling]
            else
                if !haskey(expanded,current.spelling)
                    expanded[current.spelling] = expand!(expander,raw[current.spelling],context)
                end
                sequence = expanded[current.spelling]
            end
            if isempty(sequence)
                push!(items,[PPToken("placemarker","",current.line,current.space)])
            else
                push!(items,[token_with(sequence[1];space=current.space);sequence[2:end]])
            end
        else
            push!(items,[current])
        end
        index += 1
    end
    pasted,index = PPToken[],1
    while index <= length(items)
        item = items[index]
        if item isa PPToken
            left = pop!(pasted)
            right = items[index+1]
            right isa PPToken && (right = [right])
            append!(pasted,paste_tokens!(expander,left,right[1],token,context))
            append!(pasted,right[2:end])
            index += 2
        else
            append!(pasted,item)
            index += 1
        end
    end
    result,carry_space = PPToken[],false
    for current in pasted
        if current.kind == "placemarker"
            carry_space |= current.space
        else
            push!(result,token_with(current;line=token.line,space=current.space || carry_space,hide=union(current.hide,hide)))
            carry_space = false
        end
    end
    isempty(result) || (result[1] = token_with(result[1];space=token.space))
    result
end
function expand!(expander,sequence,context)
    pending,result = reverse(sequence),PPToken[]
    while !isempty(pending)
        token = pop!(pending)
        if token.kind != "identifier" || token.spelling in token.hide
            push!(result,token)
            continue
        elseif token.spelling in BUILTINS
            push!(result,expand_builtin!(expander,token,context))
            continue
        end
        definition = get(expander.macros,token.spelling,nothing)
        if definition === nothing || (definition.parameters !== nothing && (isempty(pending) || pending[end].spelling != "("))
            push!(result,token)
            continue
        end
        raw = Dict{String,Vector{PPToken}}()
        hide = union(token.hide,Set([definition.name]))
        if definition.parameters !== nothing
            collected = collect_arguments!(expander,pending,definition,token,context)
            if collected === nothing
                push!(result,token)
                continue
            end
            raw,consumed,closing = collected
            resize!(pending,length(pending)-consumed)
            hide = union(intersect(token.hide,closing.hide),Set([definition.name]))
        end
        replacement = substitute!(expander,definition,raw,token,hide,context)
        definition.expanded += 1
        if isempty(replacement) && token.space && !isempty(pending)
            pending[end] = token_with(pending[end];space=true)
        end
        append!(pending,reverse(replacement))
    end
    result
end

const LEVELS = [Set(["||"]),Set(["&&"]),Set(["|"]),Set(["^"]),Set(["&"]),Set(["==","!="]),Set(["<",">","<=",">="]),Set(["<<",">>"]),Set(["+","-"]),Set(["*","/","%"])]
struct ExpressionError <: Exception
    message::String
end
function integer_value(spelling)
    value = spelling
    for suffix in ("ll","LL","l","L")
        if endswith(value,suffix) && length(value) > length(suffix)
            value = value[1:end-length(suffix)]
            break
        end
    end
    occursin(r"^0[xX][0-9a-fA-F]+$",value) && return parse(Int64,value[3:end];base=16)
    occursin(r"^0[0-7]*$",value) && return parse(Int64,value;base=8)
    occursin(r"^[1-9][0-9]*$",value) && return parse(Int64,value)
    throw(ExpressionError("invalid integer constant \"$spelling\""))
end
function character_value(spelling)
    value = spelling[2:end-1]
    length(value) == 1 && !(value[1] in ('\'','\\')) && return Int64(value[1])
    escapes = Dict('n'=>10,'t'=>9,'\\'=>92,'\''=>39,'"'=>34,'0'=>0)
    length(value) == 2 && value[1] == '\\' && haskey(escapes,value[2]) && return Int64(escapes[value[2]])
    throw(ExpressionError("invalid character constant " * spelling))
end
struct PPExpression
    kind::String
    value::Any
    children::Vector{PPExpression}
end
pp_expression(kind,value=nothing,children=PPExpression[]) = PPExpression(kind,value,children)
mutable struct ExpressionParser
    tokens::Vector{PPToken}
    index::Int
end
next_spelling(parser) = parser.index <= length(parser.tokens) ? parser.tokens[parser.index].spelling : nothing
function parse_conditional!(parser)
    left = parse_binary!(parser,1)
    if next_spelling(parser) == "?"
        parser.index += 1
        first = parse_conditional!(parser)
        next_spelling(parser) == ":" || throw(ExpressionError("'?' without following ':'"))
        parser.index += 1
        left = pp_expression("conditional",nothing,[left,first,parse_conditional!(parser)])
    end
    left
end
function parse_binary!(parser,level)
    level > length(LEVELS) && return parse_unary!(parser)
    left = parse_binary!(parser,level+1)
    while next_spelling(parser) in LEVELS[level]
        operator = next_spelling(parser)
        parser.index += 1
        left = pp_expression("binary",operator,[left,parse_binary!(parser,level+1)])
    end
    left
end
function parse_unary!(parser)
    if next_spelling(parser) in ("+","-","!","~")
        operator = next_spelling(parser)
        parser.index += 1
        return pp_expression("unary",operator,[parse_unary!(parser)])
    end
    parser.index > length(parser.tokens) && throw(ExpressionError("expected value at end of expression"))
    token = parser.tokens[parser.index]
    parser.index += 1
    token.kind == "number" && return pp_expression("constant",integer_value(token.spelling))
    token.kind == "character" && return pp_expression("constant",character_value(token.spelling))
    token.kind == "identifier" && return pp_expression("identifier",token.spelling)
    if token.spelling == "("
        value = parse_conditional!(parser)
        next_spelling(parser) == ")" || throw(ExpressionError("missing ')' in expression"))
        parser.index += 1
        return value
    end
    throw(ExpressionError("expected value before \"$(token.spelling)\""))
end
function parse_expression(tokens,directive)
    isempty(tokens) && throw(ExpressionError("#$directive with no expression"))
    parser = ExpressionParser(tokens,1)
    tree = parse_conditional!(parser)
    next_spelling(parser) === nothing || throw(ExpressionError("missing binary operator before \"$(next_spelling(parser))\""))
    tree
end
function binary_value(operator,first,second)
    if operator in ("/","%")
        second == 0 && throw(ExpressionError("division by zero in #if"))
        return operator == "/" ? div(first,second) : rem(first,second)
    end
    operator == "+" && return first+second
    operator == "-" && return first-second
    operator == "*" && return first*second
    operator == "<<" && return first << second
    operator == ">>" && return first >> second
    operator == "&" && return first & second
    operator == "|" && return first | second
    operator == "^" && return xor(first,second)
    operator == "==" && return Int64(first == second)
    operator == "!=" && return Int64(first != second)
    operator == "<" && return Int64(first < second)
    operator == ">" && return Int64(first > second)
    operator == "<=" ? Int64(first <= second) : Int64(first >= second)
end
function evaluate_expression(tree,warning)
    pending,values = Tuple{String,Any}[("evaluate",tree)],Int64[]
    while !isempty(pending)
        operation,item = pop!(pending)
        if operation == "evaluate"
            kind = item.kind
            if kind == "constant"
                push!(values,item.value)
            elseif kind == "identifier"
                warning("identifier \"$(item.value)\" evaluates to 0")
                push!(values,0)
            elseif kind == "unary"
                append!(pending,[("unary",item.value),("evaluate",item.children[1])])
            elseif kind == "conditional"
                append!(pending,[("choose",(item.children[2],item.children[3])),("evaluate",item.children[1])])
            elseif item.value in ("&&","||")
                append!(pending,[("logical",(item.value,item.children[2])),("evaluate",item.children[1])])
            else
                append!(pending,[("binary",item.value),("evaluate",item.children[2]),("evaluate",item.children[1])])
            end
        elseif operation == "choose"
            push!(pending,("evaluate",item[pop!(values) != 0 ? 1 : 2]))
        elseif operation == "logical"
            first = pop!(values)
            if (item[1] == "&&" && first == 0) || (item[1] == "||" && first != 0)
                push!(values,Int64(first != 0))
            else
                append!(pending,[("truth",nothing),("evaluate",item[2])])
            end
        elseif operation == "truth"
            push!(values,Int64(pop!(values) != 0))
        elseif operation == "unary"
            value = pop!(values)
            push!(values,item == "+" ? value : item == "-" ? -value : item == "!" ? Int64(value == 0) : -value-1)
        else
            second,first = pop!(values),pop!(values)
            push!(values,binary_value(item,first,second))
        end
    end
    values[1]
end

const STARTS = ("if","ifdef","ifndef")
const BRANCHES = ("elif","elifdef","elifndef","else")
function directive_name(tokens)
    length(tokens) >= 2 && tokens[1].spelling == "#" && tokens[2].kind == "identifier" ? tokens[2].spelling : nothing
end
function detect_guard(lines)
    nonempty = [logical.tokens for logical in lines if !isempty(logical.tokens)]
    isempty(nonempty) && return nothing
    first,last = nonempty[1],nonempty[end]
    length(first) == 3 && directive_name(first) == "ifndef" && first[3].kind == "identifier" || return nothing
    length(last) == 2 && directive_name(last) == "endif" || return nothing
    depth = 0
    for (index,tokens) in enumerate(nonempty)
        name = directive_name(tokens)
        name in BRANCHES && depth == 1 && return nothing
        if name in STARTS
            depth += 1
        elseif name == "endif"
            depth -= 1
        end
        depth == 0 && index != length(nonempty) && return nothing
    end
    depth == 0 ? first[3].spelling : nothing
end
mutable struct PPSourceFile
    path::String
    physical_lines::Int
    lines::Vector{LogicalLine}
    guard::Union{Nothing,String}
    once::Bool
    entered::Int
    skipped::Int
    output_lines::Int
    skipped_lines::Int
end
mutable struct IncludeManager
    files::Dict{String,PPSourceFile}
    order::Vector{String}
end
IncludeManager() = IncludeManager(Dict{String,PPSourceFile}(),String[])
function search_header(name,quoted)
    paths = quoted ? [name,"include/" * name] : ["include/" * name]
    for path in paths
        isfile(joinpath("input",path)) && return path
    end
    nothing
end
function load_source!(manager,path)
    if !haskey(manager.files,path)
        contents = read(joinpath("input",path),String)
        lines = lex_source(contents)
        manager.files[path] = PPSourceFile(path,count(==('\n'),contents),lines,detect_guard(lines),false,0,0,0,0)
        push!(manager.order,path)
    end
    manager.files[path]
end

struct PPToken
    kind::String
    spelling::String
    line::Int
    space::Bool
    hide::Set{String}
end
PPToken(kind,spelling,line,space) = PPToken(kind,spelling,line,space,Set{String}())
function token_with(token;kind=token.kind,spelling=token.spelling,line=token.line,space=token.space,hide=token.hide)
    PPToken(kind,spelling,line,space,hide)
end
struct LogicalLine
    tokens::Vector{PPToken}
    start::Int
    stop::Int
end
const PUNCTUATORS = split("... <<= >>= -> ++ -- << >> <= >= == != && || *= /= %= += -= &= ^= |= ## [ ] ( ) { } . & * + - ~ ! / % < > ^ | ? : ; = , #")
identifier_start(c) = c == '_' || 'a' <= c <= 'z' || 'A' <= c <= 'Z'
digit(c) = '0' <= c <= '9'
function read_token(text,position=1;header=false)
    character = text[position]
    if header && character == '<'
        closing,newline = findnext(==('>'),text,position+1),findnext(==('\n'),text,position+1)
        if closing !== nothing && (newline === nothing || closing < newline)
            return "header",String(text[position:closing]),closing+1
        end
    end
    if identifier_start(character)
        last = position+1
        while last <= length(text) && (identifier_start(text[last]) || digit(text[last]))
            last += 1
        end
        return "identifier",String(text[position:last-1]),last
    elseif digit(character) || (character == '.' && position < length(text) && digit(text[position+1]))
        last = position+1
        while last <= length(text)
            if text[last] in "eEpP" && last < length(text) && text[last+1] in "+-"
                last += 2
            elseif identifier_start(text[last]) || digit(text[last]) || text[last] == '.'
                last += 1
            else
                break
            end
        end
        return "number",String(text[position:last-1]),last
    elseif character in ('"','\'')
        last = position+1
        while last <= length(text) && text[last] != '\n'
            text[last] == character && return (character == '"' ? "string" : "character",String(text[position:last]),last+1)
            last += text[last] == '\\' && last < length(text) && text[last+1] != '\n' ? 2 : 1
        end
    end
    for punctuator in PUNCTUATORS
        if startswith(SubString(text,position),punctuator)
            return "punctuator",punctuator,position+length(punctuator)
        end
    end
    "other",string(character),position+1
end
function splice_lines(text)
    characters,positions = Char[],Int[]
    index,line = 1,1
    while index <= length(text)
        if text[index] == '\\' && index < length(text) && text[index+1] == '\n'
            index += 2
            line += 1
            continue
        end
        push!(characters,text[index])
        push!(positions,line)
        text[index] == '\n' && (line += 1)
        index += 1
    end
    join(characters),positions
end
function scan_tokens(text,positions,start=1)
    lines,tokens = LogicalLine[],PPToken[]
    index,spaced = 1,true
    while index <= length(text)
        pair = text[index:min(index+1,length(text))]
        if text[index] == ' '
            spaced = true
            index += 1
        elseif text[index] == '\n'
            last = positions[index]
            push!(lines,LogicalLine(tokens,start,last))
            tokens,start,spaced = PPToken[],last+1,true
            index += 1
        elseif pair == "/*"
            closing = findnext("*/",text,index+2)
            index = closing === nothing ? length(text)+1 : closing.stop+1
            spaced = true
        elseif pair == "//"
            closing = findnext(==('\n'),text,index+2)
            index = closing === nothing ? length(text)+1 : closing
            spaced = true
        else
            header = length(tokens) == 2 && tokens[1].spelling == "#" && tokens[2].spelling == "include"
            kind,spelling,last = read_token(text,index;header)
            push!(tokens,PPToken(kind,spelling,positions[index],spaced))
            index,spaced = last,false
        end
    end
    isempty(tokens) || push!(lines,LogicalLine(tokens,start,positions[end]))
    lines
end
function lex_source(text)
    spliced,positions = splice_lines(text)
    scan_tokens(spliced,positions)
end
function lex_definition(text,line)
    text *= "\n"
    [token for logical in scan_tokens(text,fill(line,length(text)),line) for token in logical.tokens]
end
function render(tokens)
    join([(index > 1 && token.space ? " " : "") * token.spelling for (index,token) in enumerate(tokens)])
end
function single_token(text)
    (isempty(text) || startswith(text,"//") || startswith(text,"/*")) && return nothing
    kind,spelling,last = read_token(text)
    last == length(text)+1 ? kind : nothing
end

include("lexer.jl")
include("definitions.jl")
include("expression.jl")
include("include_manager.jl")
include("expander.jl")
const CONDITIONALS = (STARTS...,BRANCHES...,"endif")
struct HeaderSpecification
    rendering::String
    name::String
    quoted::Bool
end
struct DirectiveError <: Exception
    message::String
end
mutable struct ConditionalBlock
    kind::String
    position::Tuple{String,Int}
    parent::Bool
    chosen::Bool
    active::Bool
    else_seen::Bool
    skip_start::Union{Nothing,Int}
end
mutable struct Inclusion
    source::PPSourceFile
    depth::Int
    display_file::String
    offset::Int
    stack::Vector{ConditionalBlock}
    segment::Vector{PPToken}
end
Inclusion(source,depth) = Inclusion(source,depth,source.path,0,ConditionalBlock[],PPToken[])
display_position(context,physical) = (context.display_file,physical+context.offset)
skipping(context) = !isempty(context.stack) && !context.stack[end].active
function separator_needed(left,right)
    left == "/" && right[1] in ('/','*') && return true
    kind,spelling,last = read_token(left * right)
